caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular piece of patterned fabric with vertical stripes of color. There are four distinct vertical sections, each containing different color backgrounds and decorative designs. From left to right, the background colors are green, blue, red, and green. On the green section at the left, a blue and brown floral pattern with a large paisley motif is present. The blue section features a similar floral and paisley pattern in brown. The red section contains a complex design with swirls and paisley shapes in black or dark brown, bordered by a scalloped edge on one side. The last section, which is green, displays a darker green floral and paisley motif. Vertical borders containing a repeated motif of cream and brown geometric shapes on a blue background frame the left and right edges of the fabric. The top and bottom edges of the fabric are frayed, and the drawing background is an off-white or light beige color.
title: Printed Textile
